messages:
sam: Started a post-deploy safety-net run for the release window — running the smokeplay suite across canary + stage.
deploy-bot: Deploy complete: release/2026-03-23-canary -> promoted to canary targets. Running postdeploy probes. (ci: 4822220001)
maya: Quick note — eu-west1 kv-probe p95 jumped to ~420ms during the first sweep. Small sample but visible.
sre-ops: grabbing logs now. Ran: tail -n 200 /var/log/smokeplay/eu-west1/kvprobe.log | sed -n '1,80p'
(we see repeated prefix-cache-miss warnings and a short spike of GC activity on host gpu-12)
alex: Can we toggle fallback-to-quant-variant for eu-west1 while we triage? That should reduce mem pressure.
nora: +1 for temporary fallback. Also suggest holding rollout to other regions for 10m until we confirm stable.
sam: Agreed. Holding global rollout. Action: pin eu-west1 traffic to v2026-03-22 (previous) and run quick synthetic seed with 1000 samples.
sre-ops: Command to pin:
```
# pin routing for eu-west1
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/route/pin \
  -d '{"region":"eu-west1","model_variant":"v2026-03-22"}'
```
I ran it and got 200 OK.
deploy-bot: Routing update complete for eu-west1 -> v2026-03-22 (effectively pinned). Synthetic-scheduler queued 1k seeds.
maya: Re-ran the smokeplay seed set. kv-probe p95 back to ~95ms. No GC blips in the next 3 runs.
alex: Looks like the newer variant has a memory growth pattern under certain prefix distributions. Filing a bug to runtime team: RT-6342.
nora: Suggestions for next steps in the runbook: 1) monitor next 15m, 2) validate end-to-end traces for 5 failing traces, 3) roll forward when stable.
sam: Will wait 15m and then decide. If still flaky, we'll keep eu-west1 pinned and proceed with a canary rollback for that pool only.
deploy-bot: Auto-check after 15m: all probes green except eu-west1 (p95 stabilized under pin). No action required.
sam: Decision: leave eu-west1 pinned and proceed with staged rollout for other regions. Add note to release notes: 'eu-west1 pinned to v2026-03-22 due to kv-probe p95 spike on canary; under investigation.'
alex: Adding priority label to RT-6342 and cc runtime@.
maya: thx — i'll collect the failing traces and add them to the bug report.
sam: Final: schedule follow-up postmortem if root cause isn't found within 48h. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
